springer_nature_policy.observed_scope: Data Availability must cover original and reused supporting data, state where data can be found and give applicable access terms even when data cannot be shared publicly.

NCBI_GEO.access_policy: NCBI encourages scientific-community access to GEO.
NCBI_GEO.use_policy: NCBI itself places no restrictions on GEO data use or distribution.
NCBI_GEO.distribution_exception: Submitters may retain patent, copyright or other intellectual-property rights; NCBI cannot grant unrestricted permission for every submitted item.

ENCODE.access_policy: Released ENCODE data are intended for rapid dissemination and unrestricted scientific use.
ENCODE.use_policy: The ENCODE portal permits download, analysis and publication of released data without general use restrictions.
ENCODE.distribution_exception: The reviewed provider policy does not separately adjudicate this project's repackaging or redistribution of the exact downloaded asset bundle.

EMBL_EBI_BIOSTUDIES_ARRAYEXPRESS.access_policy: ArrayExpress functional-genomics records are served through the BioStudies ArrayExpress collection.
EMBL_EBI_BIOSTUDIES_ARRAYEXPRESS.use_policy: The collection provides functional-genomics data and metadata for community reuse.
EMBL_EBI_BIOSTUDIES_ARRAYEXPRESS.distribution_exception: BioStudies states that new datasets use CC0, but that scope was not proven to apply retrospectively to this migrated E-MTAB record.

claim_boundary: Official provider access and analysis policies support accession citation and reused-source reporting, but do not by themselves authorize this project to redistribute study payloads. Study-specific accountable-human rights review remains required.
